ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% low-intensity pixels (black) to 15% high-intensity pixels (white/light-grey) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity white pixel clusters are located in the medial-lower regions of both lobes. High-intensity white bands are visible along the trailing edges of the fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 45-degree pixel angle and significant bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge. A distinct irregular indentation is present on the proximal trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitting the trailing edge, transitioning to upward-sweeping, tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Left lobe medial region contains a distinct high-contrast figure-8 shaped white pixel cluster. Right lobe medial region contains a cluster of three localized white circular pixel formations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Left lobe contains two parallel, diagonal linear white pixel disruptions. Right lobe contains a single, faint diagonal linear white pixel disruption.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters and distinct linear unaligned marks on both lobes as specified in the localized anomalies section.
other_distinctive_markers: The highly unique figure-8 shaped high-intensity pixel formation on the medial left lobe surface.
